description: Deterministic rights assessment bound to the exact resource version, license and intended use, and to whether the publisher's rights authority is documented (a verified domain hosting the resource). Exactly four dispositions with reason codes; no trust score.

intended_use.description: Uses to check: each true flag must be documented; omitted = false; unknown fields refused. For instance {"commercial_use":true}

duration_days.description: Whole days of use (1 to 36500), or null for no fixed term

geography.description: worldwide (default) or a region code such as US, EU, UK

name: assess_resource_for_use
title: Assess a resource for an intended use
